name: Vranken-Pommery Monopole Societe Anonyme
summary: Vranken-Pommery Monopole Société Anonyme produces and sells wines and champagnes in France and internationally. The company offers its products under the Champagne Vranken, Champagne Pommery, Monopole Heidsieck & CO, Champagne Charles Lafitte, Château la Gordonne, Domaine Royal De Jarras, Quinta do Grifo, Rozès, Pink Flamingo, Sao Pedro Das Aguias, and Louis Pommery brands. The company was founded in 1976 and is based in Reims, France.
